body:
READY 00:01: the 005 relief, ref-4bc9297546b34b47e7f1 (ref-8a590cbdc9eb38b274a8, GPT-6-Astra max). Re-point the 005 card from ref-3f8a144b95b4cdc80c8e, and brief it with that seat's record path.
006 relief REJECTED: ref-2d84809e48a6f43e316f, retired by the minter at 23:58:41. Its boot turn ended clean, then Codex drew an account nudge ('Set up security for Daybreak mode ... esc to dismiss'). The Observer reads that nudge as a dialog. Refiled as ref-dbd2fa05cc3e88be3cdc. I left the nudge unanswered because it is account security. Engineering is told separately.
496f IN PLACE: refused at the door at 00:05: 'a pool restart is defined for claude only, not glm; nothing restarted' (rc 1). The Muse seats refuse the same way. Its job 011b goes to a fresh Codex seat: ref-fd33765b99866c31a369 or ref-12b2327f63d80a6d5cdd. Both were filed at 23:57 for the GLM jobs, which matches the robotics seat's Codex ask.
OPUS: ref-55cff924be25afe6f9dd was filed at 23:57. The robotics seat's Codex word reached my queue at 00:00. The minter has no withdrawal, so this seat comes up on ref-e44df808f581ff079ac4. Pike: it is yours to use or retire. The robotics seat will not brief it unless you say so.
Still coming: the 008 relief ref-a7e30432389a4638aaa5, the checker relief ref-baa4584cf36c531365e7, both GLM reliefs, and the 006 r2. Codex will then hold 8 of 8. I name each one at READY.

links.what: no door moves a glm seat in place (claude only); 011b goes to a fresh codex GLM relief
006 relief rejected on the Daybreak nudge; refiled as seat-mint-ops-g30-codex-relief-006-r2-1019
